task.description: Diagnose and fix svc01 on_delete_cascade test failure (ISS-0640 / GH-631)
acceptance_criteria: DELETE FROM tenant schema-qualified to public.tenant
session_replication_role restored to DEFAULT before DELETE so RI_FKey_cascade_del fires

result.summary: Two-part fix applied to tests/integration/svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig: (1) Schema-qualified DELETE FROM tenant to DELETE FROM public.tenant (unqualified resolved to tenant_default.tenant under TestHarness search_path=tenant_default,public). (2) Added SET session_replication_role = DEFAULT before the DELETE — TestHarness sets replica mode to suppress audit triggers, but FK cascade trigger RI_FKey_cascade_del has tgenabled=O (origin-only) and was therefore also disabled. Verified: zig build test-integration-svc 35/35 pass.
